locationDescription: In front of Tuktukan Barangay Hall
description: A shooting occurred in front of the Tuktukan Barangay Hall. Police said two suspects were killed when an armed civilian fired back as they attempted to shoot a minor.

sourceEvidence.location: The article identifies the area in front of the Barangay Tuktukan hall.
sourceEvidence.eventFacts: The article reports a shooting involving four people and says two suspects died when an armed civilian returned fire as they attempted to shoot a minor.

description: Hours after another shooting that evening, a separate shooting occurred on Bagong Calzada Street in Tuktukan; the article reports that a minor victim was shot dead and a suspect was later arrested.

sourceEvidence.location: The article names Bagong Calzada Street, Barangay Tuktukan.
sourceEvidence.eventFacts: The article distinguishes a later shooting at Bagong Calzada Street and reports a minor victim died.

locationDescription: Street in Barangay Santa Ana; street name not reported
description: Two people, including a 13-year-old, were shot in Barangay Santa Ana on September 24, 2025. The article reports that both victims were seriously injured.

sourceEvidence.location: The article identifies Barangay Santa Ana and does not name the street.
sourceEvidence.eventFacts: The article reports two victims, including a minor, were shot and seriously injured.
